SAP Business Network for Logistics – REST API Integration series: Post #1 Saif Product and Topic Expert 2023 Sep 19 10:54 AM 6 Likes  4,805 Views Edit SAP Managed Tags Breaking down the Freight Booking API (Ocean) for Carrier Integration (1/2) Glossary: Acronym Definition BN4L Business Network for Logistics LBN Logistics Business Network (old name for BN4L) TM Transportation Management API Application Programming Interface MIL Manage Integration Logs The SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration solution connects shippers and their logistics partners on a secure network for optimized collaboration and insights, integrated tightly with core business processes for efficiency and resilience. More details can be found here. The Freight booking document is a primary transportation document for Ocean and Air. The processes supported in SAP BN4L for Ocean scenario are explained here. In this post, the focus is on usage of booking API and the minimum data that is required for a successful end-end integration.   -- 1 of 10 -- Booking Subcontracting process Pre-requisite In order for the B2B integration to work, both the carrier and the shipper will have to perform these steps in the same order: 1. Carrier to maintain webhook and its credentials. 1. Shipper to configure partner connection. Also, refer blog for tips. -- 2 of 10 -- Use Case 1: Booking Confirmation & Updates Booking confirmation and Updates As shown above, booking confirmation and updates involves several API exchanges between SAP TM, BN4L, and Carrier systems. Receiving a booking -- 3 of 10 -- An example of a Freight Booking Request that can be used to build the integration. Breaking down Business Partner details: -- 4 of 10 -- Key Business Partners and key field Note: The technicalId for the tracking process for a Booking would be different from the above. Clients should rely on the Tracking Consumer API call for the relevant technicalId. In addition to the above, the JSON has other fields within the transportationOrderBooking object, as explained below. -- 5 of 10 -- Other Business Partner details Things to know: -- 6 of 10 -- Refer to the specification for an exhaustive list of Business partner types supported by the API. Since SAP TM supports defining custom codes, BN4L supports mapping to the common definition of codes as listed here. Codes that have a mapping are explained here. So, if you are receiving codes that are not listed, shipper to check if the codes are mapped in "Assign Codes" app. URL as an attachment is not supported yet. Only files are supported. Responding to a booking -- 7 of 10 -- To respond to a booking, refer to the provider API specification that explains the various fields that can be sent to the shipper. In this post, we will focus on the bare minimum that is required for a successful Booking confirmation call. API endpoint: https://l20398- iflmap.hcisbp.eu1.hana.ondemand.com/http/v1/FreightBookingConfirmation Method: POST -- 8 of 10 -- Authentication: Use the oauth2.0 client credentials to get a token and pass on the bearer token to the API. Break down of Booking confirmation Provider API call While the below shows the minimum mandatory information required, there are more fields in the payload that can be sent back as part of the confirmation so that the shipper receives it. -- 9 of 10 -- #Sample Booking confirmation payload (When carrier is sending the co { "technicalId": "xri://sap.com/id:LBN#10010001410:QW9_172:Freight "senderParty": { "lbnId": "10010001721<Carrier>" }, "recipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001721<Carrier>" }, "documentRecipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001410<Shipper>" }, "transportationOrderBooking": { "freightBookingId": "6300003001", "acceptanceStatusCode": "AP", "baseBusinessTransactionDocumentReference": { "id": "6300003001", "typeCode": "1122" } } } -- 10 of 10 --

file://api-specs/split/01SAP Business Ne.content: #Sample Booking confirmation payload (When Network Partner is sendin { "technicalId": "xri://sap.com/id:LBN#10010001410:QW9_172:Freight "senderParty": { "lbnId": "10010002311<Network Partner>" }, "recipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001721<Carrier>" }, "documentRecipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001410<Shipper>" }, "transportationOrderBooking": { "freightBookingId": "6300003001", "acceptanceStatusCode": "AP", "baseBusinessTransactionDocumentReference": { "id": "6300003001", "typeCode": "1122" } } } Of course, one could send more than what is shared above, in that case, make sure you understand the datatypes of the various fields published in the API spec above and the supported code lists for some of the fields (egs: UOM). BN4L only accepts these whitelisted values. Note: Shippers need to enable carriers to send attachments. Without this, carriers will not be able to send attachments. Things to be aware of with this API: The API will complain with the below error if you send the wrong carrier LBN ID in the payload -- 1 of 4 -- Gives a 401 Unauthorised if you send the wrong credentials, as shown below. Sometimes, you may send the wrong shipper LBN ID, miss a mandatory field in the payload, or send incorrect data. In some cases, you may receive a 200 OK, and it may look like the API call was successful, but there are other asynchronous calls that happen in the background which may fail. Hence, these are logged in the Manage Integration Logs app. Make sure to check the app, if you feel, your updates are not going through. Or if the shipper complains that the updates are not received. In the below case, the wrong recipient LBN IDs were sent. -- 2 of 4 -- Note: The shipper will also have an equivalent Manage Integration Logs application where they will be able to monitor calls between the Network and TM. If there are no supporting logs in your MIL application, you can also double-check for any logs with the shipper. Receiving updates to a booking Updates to a booking can be done by a shipper at any point, typically before or after confirmation. Usually, changes are not made once the booking is in execution. BN4L, uses the same POST API used to receive a booking to also send updates. The payload has "actionCode" field which distinguishes if it is a Create or an Update. "01" - Create | "02" - Update More Booking scenarios/use cases are continued at SAP Business Network for Logistics – REST API Integration series: Post #2 -- 3 of 4 -- Subscribe for updates via the RSS feeds. Also, subscribe to the tags to get updates on new content. More details can be found here. The Freight booking document is a primary transportation document for Ocean and Air. The processes supported in SAP BN4L for Ocean scenario are explained here. In this post, the focus is on usage of booking API and the minimum data that is required for a successful end-end integration. -- 2 of 9 -- Booking Subcontracting process Use Case 2: Shipping Instructions and VGM Shipping Instructions and Booking Cancellation Waybill notification is sent by the Shipper through their TM system and the Carriers get the Shipping Instructions and VGM through the FreightBookingWaybillNotificaiton API. This is a -- 3 of 9 -- POST call that creates and also sends SI & VGM updates. An example of a shipping instruction. Some of the key fields and the breakdown of the exemplary payload is shown below: Note: The data in the waybill notification is subject to the level of detail a shipper maintains and shares with the carriers. -- 4 of 9 -- -- 5 of 9 -- Note: If you are not receiving dangerous goods information, see if you have implemented this note, which could be filtering out non-main items. Use Case 3: Booking cancellation -- 6 of 9 -- Booking cancellation Freight Bookings can be canceled by the Shipper and this Business event will be triggered by BN4L and delegated to Carriers and Network Partners via the consumer API for Booking Cancellation. The example payload looks like below: -- 7 of 9 -- { "documentRecipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001721", "standardIds": [{ "schemeAgencyId": "TM", "schemeId": "", "value": "0001010581" }, { "schemeAgencyId": "182", "schemeId": "", "value": "LBNT" }, { "schemeAgencyId": "182", "schemeId": "", "value": "SCSF" }] }, "transportationOrderBooking": { "ordinalNumber": 3, "externalDocumentIdentifier": "", "freightBookingId": "6300003001", "baseBusinessTransactionDocumentReference": { "id": "6300003001", "version": "0001010581-0003", "typeCode": "1122" } }, "senderParty": { "lbnId": "10010001410", "standardIds": [{ "schemeAgencyId": "TM", "schemeId": "", "value": "LBNFBSHP03" }, { "schemeAgencyId": "009", "schemeId": "", "value": "GLN00001" }] }, "recipientParty": { "lbnId": "10010001721", "standardIds": null }, -- 8 of 9 -- "originatorId": "QW9_172", "technicalId": "xri://sap.com/id:LBN#10010001410:QW9_172:Freight } Subscribe for updates via the RSS feeds. file://api-specs/split/04_BN4L_Carrier_I.content: 111 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only API Integration Implementation Effort Estimate – guidance only Note: the efforts can differ based on scenarios, capacity and skillset. 10d 10d 15d 10d 5d Tendering Subcontracting Subcontracting - Booking Invoicing Tracking Outbound Inbound -- 1 of 7 -- 112 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only Consumer APIs / EDI Requirements API Shipper CPC Required Exact Endpoint Required Freight Tendering No Yes Freight Subcontracting No Yes Freight Booking Yes No Order Tracking Yes No External Planning Yes No EDI Shipper CPC Required Freight Subcontracting No Order Tracking Yes Freight Booking* Yes * Ocean Booking has extremely limited support -- 2 of 7 -- 113 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only Shipper is in control of enabling carrier side Consumer APIs They do this with the Configure Partner Connection app Optionally can add custom request headers needed by the carrier Can also optionally configure authorization for carrier integration (not common) Can configure at different levels of granularity. Shipper’s Configure Partner Connection app -- 3 of 7 -- 114 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only Integration Error Email Notifications Carriers can configure email notifications to be sent out when errors occur. Two step process: • Manage Notification Settings app – Tenant admins can turn on notifications • Define User Settings app – All tenant users can subscribe to email notifications – Subscribe to Integration Errors V2, Invoice with API Error – Many other notifications you can subscribe to -- 4 of 7 -- 115 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only Network Partners are a special tenant type that allows them to receive data on behalf of carriers on the network – Used for SAP Partner Solutions on BN4L For example: a Freight Order is sent to a carrier tenant for confirmation, but when the tracking request is sent it is instead sent to a Visibility Provider “Network Partner” The routing is controlled in the Shipper’s CPC app Blog – Understanding Network Partner Integration Network Partners -- 5 of 7 -- 116 INTERNAL – SAP and Partners Only Carriers can order a test tenant here. By default, test tenants are in the EU DC. To get on in the US DC type “US20” in the PO-Number field during checkout. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- APIs in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration Shippers and carriers can use the APIs in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration, to simplify freight tendering, subcontracting, and dock appointment scheduling processes. Code Lists SAP Business Network for Logistics has defined its own code values for the various attributes used within SAP Business Network for Logistics. These codes are used during B2B communication so using APIs in SAP Business Network for Logistics. For more information on codes supported by business network, see Code Lists. API Payload Limits To prevent APIs from being overloaded by the payload size, we have introduced API payload limits to regulate the API usage per tenant. The use by client applications or background job threads that make multiple high-volume calls continuously to extract or import data, or update can cause performance issues. The following list provides the overview of the proposed maximum number of items per document for various APIs: API Name Technical Name Maximum Number of Items per Document Provider API to Create Freight Request for Quotation TransportationOrderQuotationCreateRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Cancel Freight Request for Quotation TransportationOrderQuotationCancellationRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Notify Freight Quotation TransportationOrderQuotationNotification_Out 700 Provider API to Create Freight Order for Subcontracting TransportationOrderRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Cancel Freight Order for Subcontracting TransportationOrderCancellationRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Create Freight Booking TransportationOrderBookingRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Cancel Freight Booking TransportationOrderBookingCancellationRequest_Out 700 Provider API for Freight Booking Waybill Notification TransportationOrderBookingWaybillNotification_Out 700 Provider API to Create Freight Order for Settlement TransportationOrderRequest_Out 700 Provider API to Confirm Freight Order Dispute Charges TransportationOrderChargeElementConfirmation_Out 700 If a document reaches the maximum item count, the system rejects the document. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 2 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- Rate Limiting API requests for SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration are subject to rate limits. Rate limits restrict the number of requests made by a caller within a defined time period. Batch jobs in external systems can cause a sudden high load in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration which may not comply with the fair usage policy. Hence, it is recommended that you use higher rate limits for critical time bound processes, which are available only for a certain period of time. For non-critical processes, you can phase the requests through the day based on the rate limits. When you exceed the rate limit, your request may be rejected by the network. The rate limits are as follows: The rate limit per tenant is 1 request per second. The rate limit per tenant is 5 requests per second for 4 hours in a day beyond which the rate limit switches back to 1 request per second. This rate limit is applicable across all message types in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration. Carrier APIs (REST APIs) As a carrier, you can use the APIs in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration to perform your daily tasks in the areas of freight tendering, freight subcontracting, freight booking, freight tracking, and freight settlement. Note that when you pass a value for a field using the REST APIs in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration, you must ensure that the length of the value adheres to the maximum length specified for the particular field in the shipper’s transportation management system. Freight Contracting The freight contracting process comprises of the freight subcontracting and tendering processes. Subcontracting You can participate in freight tendering when an ordering party sends you a freight request for quotation (freight RFQ). Your options for responding to the received freight RFQ are determined by the tendering setup implemented by the ordering party. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight tendering: You can use the Provider API for Freight Tendering to accept or reject a freight request for quotation. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Tendering to create or cancel a freight request for quotation in an external system. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Tendering to award or reject a freight quotation in an external system. More Information Freight Tendering. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 3 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- Subcontracting As a subsequent step to tendering process, if an ordering party wants to subcontract the transportation of goods to you, you can use the freight subcontracting APIs. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight subcontracting: You can use the Provider API for Freight Subcontracting to confirm or reject a freight order for subcontracting. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting to create, update, or cancel a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting to award a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. More Information Subcontracting Consumer API for Freight Tendering As a carrier, you can use this consumer API to manage freight requests for quotation and freight quotations as part of the freight tendering process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. Description You can use this outbound API to perform the following: Create Freight Request for Quotation Enables you to create a freight request for quotation in an external system. Cancel Freight Request for Quotation Enables you to cancel a freight request for quotation in an external system. Freight Quotation Enables you to award or reject a freight quotation in an external system. Additional Information If the Currency Change Enabled indicator is enabled by the ordering party, you can change the price proposal currency in the freight request for quotation. If it is disabled, then you cannot modify the price proposal currency. For the TransportModeCode attribute, when the ordering party sends a value from their external transportation system, the respective value that you receieve in SAP Business Network for Logistics might be different as the static mapping of values between these two systems are different. Transport Mode Codes SAP Transportation Management System SAP Business Network for Logistics System 03 - Ocean 01 - Ocean 01 - Road 03 - Road 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 4 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- SAP Transportation Management System SAP Business Network for Logistics System 05 - Air 04 - Air Provider API for Freight Tendering As a carrier, you can use this provider API to manage freight requests for quotation and freight quotations as part of the freight tendering process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. Enables you to create a freight quotation for a freight request for quotation in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Description You can use this inbound API to accept or reject a freight request for quotation. When accepting, you can perform the following if permitted by the ordering party: Propose an alternative price The alternative price is the amount for which you agree to execute the transportation. Propose alternative loading and unloading times for transportation stages The alternative times are the points in time for which you agree to accept the freight request for quotation. When rejecting, you can provide a reason code. Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting As a carrier, you can use this consumer API to manage freight orders for subcontracting process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. Description You can use this outbound API to perform the following: Create Freight Order for Subcontracting Enables you to create a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. The system calls this API when an ordering party creates a freight order for subcontracting. Update Freight Order for Subcontracting Enables you to update a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. The system calls this API when an ordering party updates a freight order for subcontracting. Cancel Freight Order for Subcontracting Enables you to cancel a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. The system calls this API when an ordering party cancels a freight order for subcontracting. Award Freight Order for Subcontracting 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 5 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- Enables you to award a freight order for subcontracting in an external system. The system calls this API when an ordering party awards a freight order for subcontracting to you. Provider API for Freight Subcontracting As a carrier, you can use this provider API to manage freight orders for subcontracting process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. The ordering party sends a freight order from their transportation system to SAP Business Network for Logistics. If you have integrated to the freight order confirmation process using the Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting, then it would be available in your backend system. You can use this inbound API to create a response for a freight order for subcontracting in SAP Business Network for Logistics. With this functionality, you can confirm or reject a freight order for subcontracting. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 7 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- When confirming, you can perform the following if permitted by the ordering party: Propose an alternative price (in case of direct tendering) The alternative price is the amount for which you agree to execute the transportation. Provide driver names and vehicle details. Don't provide these information for consignment orders. Provide notes and attachment documents Provide container identification numbers and reference document number When rejecting, you can provide a reason code. Description You can use this inbound API to create a response for a freight order (or direct tendering) in SAP Business Network for Logistics. With this functionality, you can confirm or reject a freight order. The ordering party sends a freight order for the reservation of freight space from their transportation system to SAP Business Network for Logistics. If you have integrated the freight order confirmation process using the Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting, then it would be available in your backend system. You can respond to the freight order by either confirming or rejecting using the Provider API for Freight Subcontracting. You can submit a payload with confirmation soon after you receive a freight order. Later, you can update the details and resend your confirmation. Additionally, you can view the road freight orders in Freight Order for Confirmation app in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Whenever there is direct tendering involved, you can see the freight orders using the same app with remaining time to respond back. You must ensure that you respond before the remaining time. Every update for direct tendering creates a new quotation in the shipper tenant in the external transportation system. Freight Booking Using the freight booking APIs, you can review and confirm freight bookings that ordering parties ask you to execute. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight booking: You can use the Provider API for Freight Booking to confirm or reject a freight booking. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Booking to create or cancel a freight booking request in an external system. You can use the Consumer API for Freight Booking to create or update a freight booking waybill information in an external system. Description 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 11 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- You can use this inbound API to create a response for a freight booking in SAP Business Network for Logistics. With this functionality, you can confirm or reject a freight booking. The ordering party sends a freight booking for the reservation of freight space from their transportation system to SAP Business Network for Logistics. If you have integrated the freight booking confirmation process using the Consumer API for Freight Booking, then it would be available in your backend system. You can respond to the freight booking by either confirming or rejecting using the Provider API for Freight Booking. You can submit a payload with confirmation soon after you receive a freight booking. Later, you can update the details and resend your confirmation. For example, you can update the cut-off dates, VGM cut-off (for ocean freight booking only), arrival and departure dates for different stops, reference document numbers, and so on. Additionally, you can view the air freight bookings in Confirm Freight Bookings (Air) app and ocean freight bookings in Confirm Freight Bookings (Ocean) app in SAP Business Network for Logistics. For more information, see Confirm Freight Bookings (Ocean) and Confirm Freight Bookings (Air). If the airline code is not assigned (or incorrectly maintained) by shipper to the carrier, sending JourneyID (Flight Code is the UI field) in the provider API would fail at the shipper backend system in case of air freight booking. By sending ItemIDs that are not part of the consumer API will give an error in the provider API. The shipper can maintain the necessary settings to disable you from adding attachments. In this scenario, if you respond back to the shipper with an attachment, then the response fails. Freight Tracking You can use the tracking process to keep your ordering parties informed about the transportation of their freight. Using the freight tracking APIs, you can create or update tracking requests and post events. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight booking: You can use the Provider API for Order Events (FC) to post events. You can use the Consumer API for Order Tracking (FC) to create, update, or delete a tracking request in an external system. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 13 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- More Information Freight Orders for Reporting Consumer API for Order Tracking (FC) As a carrier, you can use this consumer API to create or update a tracking request when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. Description You can use this outbound API to perform the following: Create Tracking Request Enables you to create a tracking request in an external system. Delete Tracking Request Enables you to delete a tracking request in an external system. Provider API for Order Events (FC) As a carrier, you can use this provider API to post events for an order. The events will be posted in SAP Business Network for Logistics and then forwarded to the system where the order was initially created. Description You can use this inbound API to create an event in a tracked order in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can use this API to post events to SAP Business Network for Logistics. With this, the shipper can see the events in their external system and in SAP Business Network for Logistics as well. Freight Settlement Using the freight settlement API, you can perform freight settlement with your ordering party. You can use the Provider API for Invoicing to create an invoice request. More Information Manage Invoices Provider API for Invoicing As a carrier, you can use this provider API to manage invoicing process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems. Description 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 14 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- You can use this inbound API to create an invoice. The ordering party sends a freight order from their transportation system to SAP Business Network for Logistics. If you have integrated to the freight order confirmation process using the Consumer API for Freight Subcontracting, then it would be available in your backend system. You can create an invoice for this freight order using the Provider API for Invoicing. You can submit a payload with the charges that match the freight order an invoice is created in SAP Business Network for Logistics in the carrier tenant. Additionally, you can view the freight order for invoicing in the Invoice Freight Documents app in SAP Business Network for Logistics. If there is any mismatch in the charges, the system creates a dispute either in the ordering party’s SAP Business Network for Logistics ordering party tenant or the external transportation system depending on the settings that the ordering party has specified in their General Settings app. The system also creates an invoice corresponding to the freight order sent by the ordering party in the carrier tenant in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can view the freight order sent by the ordering party in the Invoice Freight Documents app and the corresponding invoice in the Manage Invoices app. For more information on how to manage the documents in these apps, see Invoice Freight Documents and Manage Invoices. Provide the LBN ID of purchasing party and bill from party in payload. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- Planning in External System The ordering party creates transportation requirements from a sales order, purchase order, or delivery documents in their SAP Transportation Management system. The ordering party can send these transportation requirements to you and request you to perform planning activities in your system. Once you create a planned freight document in your system, you can send the document containing the transportation requirements back to the ordering party. Shipper APIs (SOAP APIs) As a shipper, you can use the APIs in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration to perform your daily tasks in the areas of freight tendering, freight subcontracting, freight booking, freight tracking, dock appointment scheduling, and freight settlement. Outsourced Planning You can create transportation requirements from a sales order, purchase order, or delivery documents in your SAP Transportation Management system and send these transportation requirements to the carrier to request the carrier to perform planning activities in their system. Once the carrier creates a planned freight document in their system, they can send the document containing the transportation requirements back to you. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight settlement: You can use the Provider API to Receive Freight Documents for Outsourced Planning to forward a freight document to your SAP Business Network for Logistics system. You can use the Consumer API to Send Freight Documents for Outsourced Planning to receive freight documents in your transportation management system. The planned freight document will be sent by your external planner. Structure For more information, see Maintain Generic Transportation Order. Freight Contracting The freight contracting process comprises of the freight subcontracting and tendering processes. Tendering Using the freight tendering APIs, you as a shipper can create, update, cancel, or notify various tendering activities when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with external systems. You can use the Provider API to Notify Freight Quotation to notify freight quotation statuses in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can use the Consumer API to Create or Update Freight Quotation to create or update a freight quotation in your transportation management system. Maintaining package descriptions In the Assign Codes app, you can specify the package material type descriptions. On the left pane, in the Items section, choose the Packaging Material Type. On the right pane, specify the packaging codes in your external transportation system and the corresponding LBN Code. Maintaining Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) The SCAC is a standardized code to identify carriers in transportation processes. In SAP Transportation Management it is used in freight orders and freight bookings to identify respective carriers. You can assign SCAC code to a carrier using transaction BP. Select the business partner role as carrier. In the Identification tab, under Identification Numbers section, you can specify the SCAC code. In the IDType column, from the value help, choose BUP006, which is the Standard Carrier Alpha Code. Specify an identification number. Once you assign a SCAC to a carrier, you can now find your carrier in your transportation documents such as the freight order, freight booking, and so on. Interface Node Description LocationBulkReplicateRequestMessage Bulk Service MessageHeader Message Header for the Bulk Service LocationReplicationRequestMessage Per location, contains message header, location information and address The MessageHeader → CreationDateTime field will be used to determine if the update will be processed or skipped. In case the CreationDateTime will not be present, the message will always be processed as the latest update. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 35 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- Interface Node Description MessageHeader Header Information Location Location IDs, Location Type Code, Description, Alternative Identifiers Address Address Fields Provider API for Dock Appointment Scheduling As a shipper, you can use this inbound service to create dock appointment requests and confirmed dock appointments in SAP Business Network for Logistics based on the information from your external systems such as a transportation system, warehouse management system, yard management system and so on. You can also use this service to provide a guest user access to your customers and carriers who are not on SAP Business Network for Logistics and enable them to maintain the appointment details. Technical Name GenericAppointment_In Description In general, you can create or update appointment requests with this API. In addition to that, you can create or update booked appointments with this API. You can also update appointment requests to booked appointments. Appointment requests are not yet scheduled appointments. They are assigned to a docking location and optionally also to a loading point but not to a time slot. Thus, they do not consume capacity on a loading point. Appointment requests have the appointment status as 01. Booked appointments are scheduled appointments, which means they have been assigned to a time slot on a certain loading point and consume its capacity. Booked appointments have the appointment status as 03. Appointment requests can be changed to booked appointments either via this API or via the shipper UI (Manage Dock Appointments app) or the carrier UI (Self- Book Dock Appointments app) by assigning a time slot on a certain loading point to them. In more detail, you can perform the following in SAP Business Network for Logistics using this API: Create an appointment request Note that to create an appointment request, you must send the appointment status as 01 from your external system to the network. You might want to provide a new appointment external ID at this point. The corresponding appointment ID for the new appointment request is generated in the system. Book an appointment  Note To avoid messages out of sequence or late runners overwriting newer updates, the processing of these late runner messages will be skipped. The MessageHeader → CreationDateTime field will be used to determine if the update will be processed or skipped. In case the CreationDateTime will not be present, the message will always be processed as the latest update. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 36 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- Note that to book an appointment, you must send the appointment status as 03 (or 02) and the appointment key from your external system to the network. Update an appointment request Note that to update an appointment request, you must send the appointment status as 01 and the appointment key from your external system to the network. Update a booked appointment Note that to update a booked appointment, you must send the appointment status as 03 and the appointment key from your external system to the network. Prerequisites You have performed the following: You have created a shipper and carrier business partner in your SAP Business Network for Logistics and your external system. In your external system, you have the LBN ID and you have mapped the LBN ID with the business partner. You have created the location master data and corresponding loading point and docking location in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You must use this location ID and loading point ID in the webservice SOA Manager interface. Appointment Key Appointments can be uniquely identified by a combination of the sender system ID and the appointment external ID that was used to create them, or by the appointment ID. The appointment ID is generated as a consecutive number during the creation of an appointment within the network, and it is shown in the UI. Structure They system has different fields categorized under different nodes. Each node contains various fields. Below are some of the important fields displayed by the system: Technical Name Field Description Node OrderingPartyLbnId Ordering Party LBN ID* Contains the ordering party ID maintained in SAP Business Network for Logistics Appointment CarrierLbnId Carrier LBN ID* Contains the carrier ID maintained in SAP Business Network for Logistics Appointment SenderSystemId Sender System ID* Contains the ID of sender system (see also AppointmentExternalId) Appointments AppointmentId Appointment ID A consecutive number that serves as a key for the Appointment  Note The network accepts only 700 cargo items in an API call. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 37 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- Technical Name Field Description Node appointment. It is sent back to the caller via GenericAppointment_Out after the creation of an appointment in the network. AppointmentStatusCode Appointment Status Code Contains one of the following status codes: 01 – Appointment Request Created 02 – Pending Confirmation 03 – Confirmed Appointments AppointmentExternalId Appointment External ID An externally provided key for the appointment. It is provided during creation and then used during update operations. The key is unique in combination with the sender system ID. Appointment DockingLocationId Docking Location ID* Represents the location ID assigned to a docking loaction in the Manage Entities app. Example: QM7_910:LBN_WDF (<SourceSystem>: <ExternalID>) For more information about locations, see: Viewing a Location. Appointment LoadingPointId Loading Point ID Represents the loading point ID defined in the Manage Entities app (for example: Loading_Point_ID_1). This field is not required for appointment request creation but is required when creating a booked appointment. If the loading point ID is provided already for the appointment request, it cannot be changed anymore during appointment booking via the shipper or carrier UI. However, it still can be changed by the current API. Appointment LoadingActivityType Loading Activity Type Contains one of the following activity types: 01 – Loading 02 – Unloading 03 – Loading/Unloading Appointments 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 38 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- Technical Name Field Description Node RequestedStartDateTime Requested Start Date Time If an appointment is booked via this API with status 02 ( Pending Confirmation), this field is used for the determination of the booked timeslot. If an appointment request with status 01 ( Appointment Request Created) is created via this API, the requested dates are used to determine the planned dates. Appointment RequestedEndDateTime Requested End Date Time If an appointment is booked via this API with status 02 ( Pending Confirmation), this field is used for the determination of the booked timeslot. If an appointment request with status 01 ( Appointment Request Created) is created via this API, the requested dates are used to determine the planned dates. Appointment AcceptableStartDateTime Acceptable Start Date Time Acceptable time period corresponds to a broader horizon and overwrites the Enable Appointment Date Change setting for carriers in the Manage Entities app. This enables carriers to change the date of a dock appointment in the given acceptable time range before the cut-off time for carrier is reached. Appointment AcceptableEndDateTime Acceptable End Date Time Acceptable time period corresponds to a broader horizon and overwrites the Enable Appointment Date Change setting for carriers in the Manage Entities app. This enables carriers to change the date of a dock appointment in the given acceptable time range before the cut-off time for carriers is reached. Appointment AppointmentStartDateTime Appointment Start Date Time Used for the determination of the booked time slot in combination with appointment status 03. Appointment AppointmentEndDateTime Appointment End Date Time Used for the determination of the booked time slot in Appointment 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 39 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- Technical Name Field Description Node combination with appointment status 03. DocumentId Document ID Contains the document ID of the source business document from your external system (For example, freight order, transport unit, yard order). Appointment Reference Document CargoItemDescription Cargo Item Description Contains the cargo item description Appointment Cargo Item DangerousGoodsAreContained Dangerous Goods Are Contained Contains the information whether dangerous goods are contained Appointment Cargo Item CreatedAt Created At Contains the date and time at which the note was created Appointment Note DocumentType Document Type Contains one of the following types of reference documents: 001 – Purchase Order 58 – Inbound Delivery 73 – Outbound Delivery 111– Freight Request for Quotation 114 – Sales Order 612 – Shipment Order 614 – Freight Order 1122 – Transportation Order (Transportation Management) 1311 – Transportation Unit Appointment (Extended Warehouse Management) YO – Yard Order (Yard Logistics) Appointment Reference Document Note that the fields marked with * are mandatory fields. Confirmed If you book an appointment with status 03 (Confirmed), the system tries to book an appointment for the time slot that is defined by the appointment start date time and the appointment end date time. If this succeeds, a booked appointment with status 03 is created. Otherwise, the booking fails.  Note We do not support the extensibility feature with this service as of now. We do not support the consolidation of multiple document references to one appointment document. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 40 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 10 of 10 --

file://api-specs/split/APIs in SAP Busin.content: Pending Confirmation If you book an appointment with status 02 (Pending Confirmation), the system tries to book an appointment for the time slot that is defined by the requested start date time and the requested end date time. If this succeeds, a booked appointment with status 03 is created. If it fails due to missing capacity, only an appointment request with status 01 is created. Guest User Access You can provide a guest user access to your customers and carriers who are not on SAP Business Network for Logistics and enable them to maintain the appointment details in SAP Business Network for Logistics system. Once you provide a guest user access, the system generates an URL and sends it to the carrier in an email. To validate the authenticity of the accessing personnel, when the carrier navigates to the URL, the system prompts the carrier to enter additional appointment information such as the order number or delivery ID of the appointment. Once the carrier passes the security validation, the carrier can view the appointment details, select the time slots, and save the appointment. The customer can also invite a carrier to access this appointment and select the time slots. The appointments which allow guest user access must contain the following: Additional customer contact details such as the email address Appointment type as EX Role code as LBN_02 Document reference type as shown in the table under Structure for DocumentType. The standard IDs of the SenderParty and RecipientParty header fields must be set to your own LBN ID. You must also retrieve the email address of the customer from the business partner directory in your external system and pass the information through this service. Create an Appointment Without Reference Document The system enables you to create an appointment without a reference document. You can later add the details such as reference document details, order details, delivery ID, and so on. You can also add additional reference document details or replace a reference document. Enable Overbooking When you enable overbooking for a loading point, you can create multiple appointments or block a time slot multiple times irrespective of the capacity of the loading point. You can also enable overbooking only for a carrier or only for you as a shipper depending on your settings for that loading point. In the appointment confirmation, a new node has been added for messages. You can view the messages in the following scenarios: If a customer creates an appointment via API, the system creates a confirmation message for the same. If the loading point is not set for overbooking and if preferred time slot is not available, the system does not create the appointment and creates an error message for the same. When the customer sends the appointment with the status as Pending Confirmation and the system changes the appointment status to either Confirmed or Appointment Request Created, the system provides a message for the same. Preferred Slots / Slots Preferred by Shipper 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 41 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- When you maintain an appointment, the system displays the requested and acceptable dates for slot booking based on the following criteria: The requested dates are taken from the RequestedStartDateTime and RequestedEndDateTime fields. The acceptable dates are taken from the AcceptableStartDateTime and AcceptableEndDateTime fields. Notes and Attachments You can use this inbound API to update the SAP Business Network for Logistics system with the notes and attachments from your external systems. The attachment name must contain the file extension. Example: Attachment.pdf. Automatic Cancellation of Appointments An appointment is automatically canceled if one of the following is changed: Loading point Docking location Acceptable dates (start or end date) Requested dates (start or end date) The following exceptions apply: If the changed requested dates match the start and end date of the scheduled appointment, the appointment will not be canceled. If the start and end date of the scheduled appointment is within the range of the new acceptable start and end date, the appointment will also not be canceled. Provider API for Dock Appointment Cancellation As a shipper, you can use this inbound service to cancel the dock appointments in SAP Business Network for Logistics based on the information from your external system. You can get the details from your external systems such as a transportation system, warehouse management system, yard management system, and so on. Technical Name GenericAppointmentCancellation_In Prerequisites  Note To avoid messages out of sequence or late runners overwriting newer updates, the processing of these late runner messages will be skipped. The MessageHeader → CreationDateTime field will be used to determine if the update will be processed or skipped. In case the CreationDateTime will not be present, the message will always be processed as the latest update. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 42 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- You have performed the following: You have created a shipper and carrier business partner in your SAP Business Network for Logistics and your external system. In your external system, you have the LBN ID and you have mapped the LBN ID with the business partner. Details To cancel an appointment in SAP Business Network for Logistics, you must send the appointment ID of the appointment created or updated in your SAP Business Network for Logistics system from the external system. Consumer API for Dock Appointment Scheduling As a shipper, you can use this outbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to update your external systems with the appointment details. You can update your external systems such as a transportation system, warehouse management system, yard management system, and so on with the appointment details. Technical Name GenericAppointment_Out Description You can update a freight order, transportation unit, or yard order with the appointment ID and the appointment details created in your SAP Business Network for Logistics. Structure The system has different fields categorized under different nodes. Each node contains various fields. Below are some of the important fields displayed by the system: Technical Name Field Description Node OrderingPartyLbnId Ordering Party LBN ID* Contains the ordering party ID maintained in the SAP Business Network for Logistics system Appointments CarrierLbnId Carrier LBN ID* Contains the carrier ID maintained in the SAP Business Network for Logistics system Appointments SenderSystemId Sender System ID* Contains the ID of sender system Appointments AppointmentStatusCode Appointment Status Code* Passes one of the following status codes: 01 – Appointment Request Created 03 – Confirmed 04 – Rejected Appointments 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 43 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- Technical Name Field Description Node 05 – Freight Order Canceled 06 – Canceled by Operator 07 – Canceled by Carrier 09 - Canceled by Generic Appointment API LoadingActivityType Loading Activity Type Contains one of the following activity types: 01 – Loading 02 – Unloading 03 – Loading/Unloading Appointments Text Text Contains the reason why the appointment is canceled by the carrier or warehouse operator. Appointment Note CreatedAt Created At Contains the date and time at which the note was created Appointment Note DocumentId Document ID Contains the document ID of the source business document from your external system (For example, freight order, transport unit, yard order). Appointment Reference Document DocumentType Document Type Contains one of the following types of reference document: 1311 –Transportation Unit Appointment (Extended Warehouse Management) 1122 –Transportation Order (Transportation Management) YO –Yard Order (Yard Logistics) Appointment Reference Document Note that the fields marked with * are mandatory fields. Notes and Attachments You can use this outbound API to update the external systems with the notes from your SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can use this outbound API to update the external systems with the attachments from your SAP Business Network for Logistics. Share Appointments and Appointment Requests with Business Partners  Note As of now, we do not support the extensibility feature with this service. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 44 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- You can share a docking location with your business partners in SAP Business Network for Logistics. When an appointment request is received or an appointment is booked with this docking location in the SAP Business Network for Logistics system, you can use this outbound API to update the appointment details in the external systems. Along with your external systems, the system also updates the appointment details in the external systems of business partners with whom you have shared this docking location. Receive Error Messages in your External System You can use this API to receive error messages in your external system in case of business validation errors that may occur while processing your request to SAP Business Network for Logistics. This API sends the following information: Processing status Displays whether the status is blank (success), 1 (info), 2 (warning), or 3 (error) Correlation ID You can use this ID to view or reprocess the message in Manage Integration Logs app Log node Additional node in the API that contains the message code, message, and the severity code When a business validation error occurs, the system fills the correlation ID in the message and sets the processing status as 3 (Error). This indicates that the message processing has failed. You can use this correlation ID to find this message in the Manage Integration Logs app and check for the issue. The system also fills the log node describing the issue that occurred while processing the request. You can view below the severity codes and the error messages that can occur. Severity Codes Blank (success) 1 (info) 2 (warning) 3 (error) Message Codes and Message Message Code Message 10001 The appointment type code is invalid 10003 The carrier/ordering party LBN ID is invalid 10004 The docking location is invalid 10005 The status of the appointment is invalid 10006 The appointment date/time is invalid 10007 The docking location or loading point is invalid 10008 The appointment duration is invalid 10009 The selected date is a non-working day. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 45 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- Message Code Message 10010 No time slots are available. Please contact the warehouse operator to check docking location settings. 10011 The time slot you are trying to book does not fit any period specified in business hours 10012 No time slots are available. The selected date is fully booked. 10013 Appointment does not exist 10014 Found multiple existing appointments Provider API to Manage Gate Operations As a shipper, you can use this inbound service to update the gate logbook details in your SAP Business Network for Logistics system based on the vehicle check-in and checkout information from your external systems such as a transportation system, warehouse management system, yard management system and so on. Technical Name GenericGateProcess_In Prerequisites The appointment has been confirmed. The entity settings configuration is done, this is, the loading point, docking location, gate and yard have been created. An appointment ID exists. Gate and yard have been assigned to the location. Description You can perform the following using this API: Check-In Process If the carrier confirms an appointment, the system creates a gate logbook in the SAP Business Network for Logistics system and notifies the external systems using the GenericGateProcess_Out API. The gate operations manager can directly begin the check-in process in the external system. The gate operations manager updates the check-in details such as the check-in time, driver details, gate details, vehicle licence plate, weight and seal details, equipment details, notes, and attachments in the external system. You can use this inbound API to update your SAP Business Network for Logistics system with these details.  Note To avoid messages out of sequence or late runners overwriting newer updates, the processing of these late runner messages will be skipped. The MessageHeader → CreationDateTime field will be used to determine if the update will be processed or skipped. In case the CreationDateTime will not be present, the message will always be processed as the latest update. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 46 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- Checkout Process Once the vehicle checks out from the gate, the gate operations manager updates the checkout details such as the checkout time, driver details, gate details, vehicle license plate, weight and seal details, equipment details, notes, and attachments in the external system. When you specify a seal number, you can enter an alphanumeric value. Note that you must confirm the driver details before you can proceed with the checkout of the vehicle. You can use this inbound API to update your SAP Business Network for Logistics system with these details. Request Documents from the External System You can use this inbound API to send additional documents such as loading list and bill of lading from your external transportation system to your SAP Business Network for Logistics system. You can send one or more of the following statuses as applicable, during the gate operation process: Status Status Code Description READY_FOR_CHECKIN 01 Send this status when the gate logbook is created. You can update the gate logbook before the check-in begins, for example to update documents. CHECKIN_IN_PROGRESS 02 Send this status when the gate operations manager starts the check-in process CHECKIN_ON_HOLD 03 Send this status when the gate operations manager puts the check-in process on hold CHECKIN_SUCCESSFUL 04 Send this status when the gate operations manager completes the check-in process CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS 06 Send this status when the gate operations manager starts the checkout process CHECKOUT_ON_HOLD 07 Send this status when the gate operations manager puts the checkout process on hold CHECKOUT_SUCCESSFUL 08 Send this status when the gate operations manager completes the checkout process CHECKIN_CANCELED 09 Send this status to cancel the check-in process Reporting Events You can use this API to update your SAP Business Network for Logistics system with the events reported from your external systems. Using this API, during the check-in and checkout processes at a gate, the system updates the gate logbook document in SAP Business Network for Logistics system with the events reported by one or more business partners. You must send the following parameters in this API:  Note The network accepts only 700 cargo items in an API call. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 47 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- Technical Name Field Description eventType Event Type Contains one of the following event types: GATEIN_START – Start check-in GATEIN_END – Check-in complete GATEOUT_START – Start checkout GATEOUT_END – Checkout complete DELAYED - Delayed eventReasonCode Event Reason Code Contains one of the event reason codes for the event type DELAYED given in the table below. eventReasonDescription Event Reason Description Contains the respective description of the event reason code as given in the table below. actualBusinessTimestamp Actual Event Time Contains the actual event time actualBusinessTimezone Actual Event Time Zone Contains the time zone of the actual event DELAYED event reason codes and descriptions: Event Reason Code Description LBN_TRAFFC Traffic LBN_BRKDWN Breakdown LBN_WTGLOC Waiting at Location LBN_OTHERS Others CANCELLATION Cancellation CLEANING_STATION Cleaning Station CLEANLINESS_NOT_FIT Cleanliness not fit COMM_INSTRUCTION Communications/Instructions CONGESIONTOFBAYS Congestion of Bays CROSSOVER Crossover DOCUMENTMISSING Documents Missing/IT Failure ACCIDENT Equipment Accident or Malfunction FORCEOFNATURE Force of Nature INCORRECT Incorrect or Not Conform LACKOFSTORAGECAPA Lack of Storage Capacity LOADINGSECURING Load Securing 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 48 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- Event Reason Code Description NEARMISS Near Miss NOTAVAILABLE Not Available PACKAGINDAMAGED Packaging Damaged PREVIOUSLOADINGORUNLOADING Previous loading or unloading Point DAMAGED Product Damaged/ Contaminated PUBLICAUTHORITY Public Authorities QUANTITY Quantity SEALCOMPROMISED Seal Compromised SPILL Spill STRIKE Strike SURVEYOR Surveyor TEMPERATURE Temperature TERMINAL Terminal/ Rail/ Shipping Line THEFT Theft/Vandalism UNSAFE Unsafe Condition WRONGBEHAVIOU Wrong Behaviour Consumer API to Manage Gate Operations You can use this outbound service to update your external systems with the check-in and checkout details provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can update your external systems such as a transportation system, warehouse management system, yard management system, and so on with the check-in and checkout details. Technical Name GenericGateProcess_Out Description You can perform the following using this API: Send Check-In Details to your External System Once the SAP Business Network for Logistics system is updated with the check-in details, the system uses this outbound API to send the check-in details from your SAP Business Network for Logistics system to your external systems. The system also sends the details to the external systems of all the business partners who are associated with this gate logbook. Send Weight Details to your External System 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 49 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- You can use this outbound API to send weight details from your SAP Business Network for Logistics system to your external systems. Send Documents to your External System You can use this outbound API to send reference documents such as loading list, bill of lading from your SAP Business Network for Logistics system to your external systems. Send the Checkout Details to your External System Once the SAP Business Network for Logistics is updated with the checkout details, the system uses this API to send the checkout details from your SAP Business Network for Logistics system to your external systems. The system sends one or more of the following statuses as applicable, during this process: Status Status Code Description READY_FOR_CHECKIN 01 Sends this status when the gate logbook is created CHECKIN_IN_PROGRESS 02 Sends this status when the gate operations manager starts the check-in process CHECKIN_ON_HOLD 03 Sends this status when the gate operations manager puts the check-in process on hold CHECKIN_SUCCESSFUL 04 Sends this status when the gate operations manager completes the check-in process CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS 06 Sends this status when the gate operations manager starts the checkout process CHECKOUT_ON_HOLD 07 Sends this status when the gate operations manager puts the checkout process on hold CHECKOUT_SUCCESSFUL 08 Sends this status when the gate operations manager completes the checkout process Receive Error Messages in your External System You can use this API to receive error messages in your external system in case of business validation errors that may occur while processing your request to SAP Business Network for Logistics system. This API sends the following information: Processing status Displays whether the status is blank (success), 1 (info), 2 (warning), or 3 (error) Correlation ID You can use this ID to view or reprocess the message in Manage Integration Logs app Log node Additional node in the API that contains the message code, message, and the severity code When a business validation error occurs, the system fills the correlation ID in the message and sets the processing status as 3 (Error). This indicates that the message processing has failed. You can use this correlation ID to find this message in the Manage Integration Logs app and check for the issue. The system also fills the log node describing the issue that occurred while processing the request. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 50 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 10 of 10 --

For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 7 -- You can use this API to receive the events in your external systems as part of the gate process which has been reported through your SAP Business Network for Logistics system. Using this API, SAP Business Network for Logistics system sends the events updated in the gate logbook reported during the check-in and checkout process to your external systems. The system sends the following parameters in this API: Technical Name Field Description eventType Event Type Contains one of the following event types: GATEIN_START – Start check-in GATEIN_START – Start check-in GATEIN_END – Check-in complete GATEOUT_START – Start checkout GATEOUT_END – Checkout complete DELAYED - Delayed eventReasonCode Event Reason Code Contains one of the event reason codes for the event type DELAYED given in the table below. eventReasonDescription Event Reason Description Contains the respective description of the event reason code as given in the table below. actualBusinessTimestamp Actual Event Time Contains the actual event time actualBusinessTimezone Actual Event Time Zone Contains the time zone of the actual event DELAYED event reason codes and descriptions: Event Reason Code Description LBN_TRAFFC Traffic LBN_BRKDWN Breakdown LBN_WTGLOC Waiting at Location LBN_OTHERS Others CANCELLATION Cancellation CLEANING_STATION Cleaning Station CLEANLINESS_NOT_FIT Cleanliness not fit COMM_INSTRUCTION Communications/Instructions CONGESIONTOFBAYS Congestion of Bays CROSSOVER Crossover 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 52 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 7 -- Event Reason Code Description DOCUMENTMISSING Documents Missing/IT Failure ACCIDENT Equipment Accident or Malfunction FORCEOFNATURE Force of Nature INCORRECT Incorrect or Not Conform LACKOFSTORAGECAPA Lack of Storage Capacity LOADINGSECURING Load Securing NEARMISS Near Miss NOTAVAILABLE Not Available PACKAGINDAMAGED Packaging Damaged PREVIOUSLOADINGORUNLOADING Previous loading or unloading Point DAMAGED Product Damaged/ Contaminated PUBLICAUTHORITY Public Authorities QUANTITY Quantity SEALCOMPROMISED Seal Compromised SPILL Spill STRIKE Strike SURVEYOR Surveyor TEMPERATURE Temperature TERMINAL Terminal/ Rail/ Shipping Line THEFT Theft/Vandalism UNSAFE Unsafe Condition WRONGBEHAVIOU Wrong Behaviour Freight Tracking Using the freight tracking APIs, you can update create, update, or notify freight tracking processes when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with external systems. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight booking: You can use the Provider API to Create or Update Track Process to create a freight order for tracking in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can use the Consumer API to Notify Events to update a freight order with event information in your transportation management system. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 53 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 7 -- More Information Track Freight Movement Provider API to Create or Update Track Process As a shipper, you can create a freight order for tracking in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Technical Name TransportationOrderGenericTrackedProcessRequest_Out Description You can use this inbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create a freight order for tracking from your external system, such as a transportation management system. This will enable you to track a freight order. Structure For more information, see the following SAP Note: 2742948 . Consumer API to Notify Events As a shipper, you can update a freight order with event information in your transportation management system. Technical Name TransportationEventBulkNotification_In Description You can use this outbound service consumed by SAP Business Network for Logistics to update the event information for a freight order in your external system, such as a transportation management system. The event information is received either from a carrier or a network partner. Structure For more information, see the following SAP Note: 2742948 . Freight Settlement Using the freight settlement API, you can perform freight settlement with your ordering party. You can perform the following activities using the APIs for freight settlement: You can use the Provider API to Confirm Freight Order Dispute Charges to confirm an update of freight order charges in SAP Business Network for Logistics after dispute resolution. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 54 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 7 -- You can use the Consumer API to Update Freight Order with Dispute Charges to update dispute charges on a freight order in your transportation management system. You can use the Provider API to Create Freight Order for Settlement to create a freight order for settlement in SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can use the Consumer API to Create Invoice to create an invoice in your transportation management system. Provider API to Create Freight Order for Settlement As a shipper, you can create a freight order for settlement in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Technical Name TransportationOrderRequest_Out Description You can use this inbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create a freight order for settlement from your external system, such as a transportation management system. This request will be presented to your carriers. Note that SAP Business Network for Logistics accepts only 700 items in a freight order for settlement document. Structure For more information, see: Request Transportation Order Provider API to Create Freight Booking for Settlement As a shipper, you can create or update a freight booking for settlement in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Technical Name BNTransportationOrderChargeElementRequest_Out Description You can use this inbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create a freight booking for settlement from your external system, such as a transportation management system. This request will be presented to your carriers. Note that SAP Business Network for Logistics accepts only 700 items in a freight order for settlement document. Consumer API to Create Invoice As a shipper, you can create an invoice in your transportation management system. Technical Name 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 55 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 7 -- InvoiceRequest_In Description You can use this outbound service consumed by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create an invoice for a freight order in your external system, such as a transportation management system. The invoice is submitted by your carrier. Structure For more information, see: InvoiceRequest_In - Invoice Provider API to Confirm Freight Order Dispute Charges As a shipper, you can confirm an update of freight order charges in SAP Business Network for Logistics after dispute resolution. Technical Name TransportationOrderChargeElementConfirmation_Out Description You can use this inbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to confirm an update of freight order charges after you as a shipper have accepted the disputed charges. This call is in response of the Consumer API to Update Freight Order with Dispute Charges. Structure For more information, see the following SAP Note: 2833645 . Consumer API to Update Freight Order with Dispute Charges As a shipper, you can update dispute charges on a freight order in your transportation management system. Technical Name TransportationOrderChargeElementRequest_In Description You can use this outbound service consumed by SAP Business Network for Logistics to update a freight order in your external system, such as a transportation management system, with charges agreed after a dispute with your carrier. Structure For more information, see the following SAP Note: 2833645 . 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 56 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 7 -- Provider API to Create or Update Dispute As a shipper, you can use this interface to create or update a dispute case in your SAP Business Network for Logistics system. Technical Name TransportationDisputeCaseNotification_Out Description You can use this inbound service provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create or update the details of a dispute case on the freight cost associated with a carrier invoice or on a freight document such as a freight order, a service order, or a freight booking from your external transportation system. Structure For more information, see Dispute Case Notification Out. Consumer API to Create or Update Dispute As a shipper, you can use this interface to create or update a dispute case in your external transportation system. Technical Name TransportationDisputeCaseNotification_In Description You can use this outbound service consumed by SAP Business Network for Logistics to create or update a dispute on the freight cost associated with a carrier invoice or on a freight document such as a freight order or a freight booking in your external system, such as the transportation management system. Structure For more information, see Dispute Case Notification In. 5/12/26, 7:18 AM 57 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 7 --

Assign Codes App - A Key to Seamless Carrier Integrations on SAP Business Network for Logistics Jeff-Gebo Product and Topic Expert 2023 Feb 16 5:24 PM 8 Likes  1,898 Views Edit SAP Managed Tags Introduction SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L) provides capabilities of freight tendering, subcontracting, settlement, tracking and dock appointment scheduling by connecting business partners in the network. By joining the network, a carrier can connect and transact with any shipper on the network. BN4L offers APIs for carriers who would like to build an integration to automate the flow of documents from the network to their own systems. A single integration that can support all connections to their customers on the network. Expensive point to point integrations can become the thing of the past.   -- 1 of 3 -- Problem Statement Of course the above diagram doesn't speak to nuances required to create such an integration. SAP TM is highly configurable, each shipper could configure their own custom codes to represent things such as shipping types, unit of measures, packaging types, etc. Obviously a carrier would have a difficult time building a single integration for all shippers on the network if each shipper were sending them custom codes. That is where the Assign Codes app which is available to in the BN4L Shipper Portal comes into play. With this App a Shipper can map their custom codes to BN4L defined standard codes. The Assign Codes app is the key to a successful and seamless carrier integration. Using the Assign Codes App The Assign Codes app is available to shippers in their BN4L portal. Login to your portal and find the Assign Codes tile and click it. The app will open up and you will see a list of code types in the left hand pane. Click the code type that you want to map. Below you can see an example of mapping custom packaging material type codes to standard BN4L codes. Detailed help documentation on how to use the Assign Codes app can be found here. All of our BN4L standard code lists can be found documented here, these codes are important for both shippers and their carriers who are building integrations. Steps to Success 1. Shippers - be nice to your carriers and use the Assign Codes app so they don't have to deal with your custom codes. Make sure this step is part of your implementation plan. -- 2 of 3 -- 2. Carriers - if you are building an integration and see custom codes being sent, kindly point the shipper you are working with to this blog. If our shippers on the network do this simple step of mapping custom codes to standard codes that our carriers can understand we as a community can go a long way to streamlining supply chains around the world. A real world use case - C.H. Robinson built an integration to the network for one of our shippers. During the build out of this integration we had the shipper use the Assign Codes app to send standard codes. They successfully went live with that shipper, but more importantly they have since connected to many other shippers with that same integration. Of course, the first thing they do for each new shipper is to make sure they use the Assign Codes app. It's the key to a seamless one to many integration on the network. You can learn more about C.H. Robinson's success here. LABELS Expert Insights TAGS BN4L Lbn LBN Connectivity SAP BN4L SAPLBN Add tags Comment -- 3 of 3 --

Business Network for Logistics - Testing BN4L APIs with SAP Business Accelerator Hub ZenonK Active Participant 2025 Jan 20 1:21 PM 2 Likes  2,008 Views Edit SAP Managed Tags Shippers, Carriers and other data contributors often spend a lot of time trying to understand and use the various BN4L APIs. SAP Business Accelerator Hub has all the answers! In this blog I will show some hints and tips about how to work with SAP Business Accelerator Hub. There are many BN4L APIs. In this example I will focus on the API for Freight Order Confirmations. Open SAP Business Accelerator Hub and search for the API at https://api.sap.com/ For example I search for: Voila!   -- 1 of 5 -- Now that I have found the API I will spend some time reading all the documentation (or skip the documentation and just dive straight into the testing, but Reading the documentation will help!!). I've read the documentation (honest) and I'm now ready to test the API. First I need to enter some information about my BN4L test environment (i.e. my BN4L test carrier tenant). Before creating the environment, go to your BN4L test tenant and get the Service Credentials for Client ID and Client Secret. At the time of writing they can be found in the System Connections App: Copy/Paste to the Hub and Save: -- 2 of 5 -- Enter the required Parameters. You will probably already know the LBN IDs, freight Order number and S/4 system. I got these from a previous message that sent a freight order request to a carrier but you can also get them from elsewhere. The Body will be be prefilled with all possible parameters. In my example I simply add the carrier LBN# and 'CN 'for Confirmation. Now click Run: -- 3 of 5 -- Hopefully you now see a 200 Success message and a Confirmation appears in your systems. Alternatively, you might see an error message with clear instructions about the problem 😎 Conclusion and Next Steps I hope this blog helps you on your BN4L journey! Test the other BN4L APIs. Use the example Code Snippets in your own systems. -- 4 of 5 -- LABELS BN4L TAGS API TESTING BN4L Freight Order Confirmation Transportation Management Add tags Comment -- 5 of 5 --
